description.subtitle: Water bottle for training adidas from the Bayern Munich 750 ml - red
description.intro: Bayern's adidas canister combines functionality and passion for football. With a capacity of 750 ml, it is perfect for keeping you hydrated during workouts and matches. Its lightweight and resistant design makes it the ideal companion for any sport activity.
key_benefits: Fast hydration: Ideal for uninterrupted training.
Resistant material: Designed for intensive daily use.
Easy to clean: Compatible with dishwasher.
Retractable mouth: Hygienic, practical and without leaks.
Optimal capacity: 750 ml for full sessions.

Material resistente: Diseñado para uso diario intensivo.
